reviewScope.summary: Campaign M01 visual and scoped presentation-language revision; draft, not a full authoring-source upgrade.
evidence: Inspected committed M01: 23 units, 327 flow blocks, 152 exercise prompts, choices, hints and ordinary feedback. Full evaluator-diagnostic and browser visual inspection remain outstanding.

23 contextual examples (seven selectable) and 124 source-pinned learner-prose replacements. Original exercises, answers, identifiers, hashes, positions and progression remain unchanged. New component and browser regression checks, not yet run on this payload.

Initial run 46071603686 passed all three E2E shards but failed formatting. Run 46073104442 passed formatting, lint, typecheck and build but failed JS gzip budget (487252 > 485000). Moved visuals to a SHA-256-addressed offline presentation asset and compacted editorial keys. Both budget limits unchanged. Await fresh hosted checks.

Repository history and prior release artifacts do not contain the complete pinned producer input. Source SHA remains unchanged; source-scoped presentation fallback avoids generated-content edits. The earlier three-module ZIP is not a substitute.

Follow-up source review confirmed the visual loader checks the pinned SHA-256 and falls back to the original lesson. Corrected the contradictory review status to allow mandatory hosted measurement; no code or budget limit changed.

Run 46075518288 reached lint/format and real E2E. Unit stopped on three format warnings; E2E found a stale match prompt. Compared the exact M01 original strings and all existing E2E literal selectors against the presentation overrides; corrected the matching prompt, the changed reflection prompt and the changed incorrect-answer feedback assertion. Kept the keyboard, outcome, XP and persistence assertions. Other two interrupted browser tests were not confirmed failures. Fresh hosted format and budget checks remain required.

adversarialFindings.description: Abstract code, terminal location, file versions and error timing are hard to distinguish in prose.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Use existing visual renderer for contextual diagrams and selectable examples.

adversarialFindings.description: The external producer snapshot cannot be reproduced from available GitHub resources alone.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Keep generated artifacts intact, use an exact-source presentation-only overlay, and retain this as a draft rather than claim a complete canonical revision.

adversarialFindings.description: Presentation overrides could drift or change exercise semantics.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The source SHA must match; non-security 64-bit fingerprint plus length is verified unique among all distinct source strings by a regression test. Exercise objects are untouched. Missing or mismatched visual asset falls back to original teaching blocks.

adversarialFindings.description: Initial release unit stage failed formatting.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Typed visual helper passed formatting in second run; fresh checks required for current payload.

adversarialFindings.description: The prior candidate exceeded the JS gzip budget; the new asset-based remediation has not yet been measured.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accept only the risk of a failed validation run on this draft. The unchanged bundle budget gate must measure the new content-addressed visual asset and compact keys before release. A budget overrun is not accepted.

retrospective.summary: Proceed to hosted validation only; retain draft. No acceptance of an exceeded bundle limit, no completed editorial review, and no production authorization.
